findings.passage: However, more still needs to be done to further gun violence prevention. I support the following:
findings.note: On her campaign issues page (undated, written after the 2024 gun law was signed), she introduces a list of further steps she supports: waiting periods, microstamping and ballistic identification, and limits on buying multiple firearms.

findings.passage: The passage of An Act Modernizing Firearms Laws (H.4885), recently signed into law by Governor Maura T. Healey, is a huge victory to make Massachusetts even safer.
findings.note: Campaign issues page: she describes the 2024 firearms law (ghost guns, red flag orders) as a victory.
Campaign issues page, after describing the few states that limit how many guns can be bought in 30 days: she says Massachusetts should consider limits on bulk gun purchases.

findings.passage: Waiting period laws require a certain number of days to elapse between the buying and possession of a firearm, and can help prevent acts of gun violence driven by impulse or temporary emotions.
findings.note: Campaign issues page, under her list of items she supports: a waiting period on firearm purchases, which Massachusetts does not have.
